race.description: Christmas Race Day Packages On Sale Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BRUCEDALE (1) had one start back at Wagga in May of last year and came midfield. He has since had multiple trials to be ready for this resumption. Was backed at that debut effort so you must follow the money. TUNGAMAH TESS (14) will have admirers at her first time to the track. She was impressive last trial and finds a decent gate. Every chance she is well supported. BAR LA LA (9) ran a strong favourite on debut and was OK before failing a month later. Had plenty of time to get over that and has a lovely gate. SLATERS BOY (3) was a better run last time and he can build on that again.
